name: j-research
description: Local, keyless research tooling guidance: j-perplexica-search (bounded Vane/Perplexica search with citations) and j-deep-research (Local Deep Research MCP: search, quick_research, detailed_research over the local SearXNG + LM Studio, with the measured latencies and call budgets). Requires the ~/.infra stack (bin/start, bin/setup-mcp). `practice-research`: research a collaboration, product or delivery practice from primary sources with a source ledger. `sync-perplexity`: sync Perplexity library threads into the vault.
